narrative.overview: The brand's glossy red-and-green logo is the only loud object on the page. Everything else is a calm, mineral-white ground that real photography lights up. Green leads; red punctuates and never shares a large area with green. Dark forest bands carry the partner map, the B2B offer and the footer. The phone is the primary screen.
keyCharacteristics: Bright ground, sage tiles, forest bands; one saturated lime for action.
Real product photography only; white-background packs multiply into sage tiles.
Montserrat headings with tight tracking over a clean body face (Onest for Kazakh).
Pills for controls, 20px for cards, an arch frame for the hero product.
One authored motion moment; everything else is still or reveals once.

rules.name: The Lime-Needs-Ink Rule
rules.body: Text on the brand lime is ink, never white.

rules.name: The Never-Equal Rule
rules.body: Red and green never share a large area at similar weight.

rules.name: The Four-Script Rule
rules.body: Every string must render in all four languages without a fallback glyph.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Headings carry their own weight; no small uppercase label sits above a heading.

rules.name: The Light-Bevel Rule
rules.body: The only skeuomorphism is a light bevel on lime buttons and the WhatsApp float.

dos: Do put ink text on lime and white text only on Deep Green, Forest or Deep Red.
Do multiply white-background pack shots into the sage tile.
Do keep every control at least 44px with hover, focus-visible and active states.
Do animate only transform and opacity with an exponential ease-out.
Do keep prices, stock, partners and product facts in the content files.
donts: Don't use gradient text, decorative glass, glow, or hard offset shadows.
Don't place a small label above a heading or number the sections.
Don't use transition: all, a 100vw width, or touch-action that blocks vertical scrolling.
Don't show unverified partners, invent product facts, or make medical promises.
Don't use red and green at equal weight in the same large area.
